license: WCAG 2.2 (W3C) and PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1) are cited, not copied; the overflow, contrast and formula estimates are ported from OfficeCLI under Apache-2.0 (THIRD_PARTY.md). Rule wording: Apache-2.0 with this repository.
source: The floor any Office output should pass, whatever the task. The slide overflow estimate, the dark-on-dark rule and the formula issue types are ported from OfficeCLI (Apache-2.0, see THIRD_PARTY.md). Contrast ratios follow WCAG 2.2. FLOOR-PDFUA runs veraPDF, a separate optional tool, against PDF/UA-1 (ISO 14289-1). 1.1.0 adds FLOOR-OVERLAP, also ported from OfficeCLI, after a real deck shipped with text behind pictures.

rules.text: The file uses at most two font families, resolved through runs, styles and the theme.
rules.source: House convention, not a published standard: at most two families, so the model cannot drift between typefaces. Kept because a mixed-font file is the most common visible slip; a brand kit or a style (APA 7 §2.19) that names its own fonts wins.

rules.text: No text is estimated to overflow its slide shape, and no cell text or number is cut by its column or row.
rules.source: A defect check, not a style rule: text cut off by its box is lost to the reader. The estimate is ported from OfficeCLI (Apache-2.0, see THIRD_PARTY.md).

rules.text: Text with a set colour has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its set background, or 3:1 for large text.
rules.source: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text (at least 18 pt, or 14 pt bold), with WCAG's relative luminance formula.

rules.text: Every formula carries a saved result and none is an error value.
rules.source: A defect check: ECMA-376 (Office Open XML) stores a formula's last result in the cell's value; a formula with no saved result shows nothing until recalculated, and an error value is a broken sum. Issue types ported from OfficeCLI.

rules.text: The file has a title in its properties; slides have titles, pictures have alternative text, sheets are named and documents declare a language.
rules.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.2 Page Titled (a title), SC 1.1.1 Non-text Content (alternative text), SC 3.1.1 Language of Page (a declared language); slide titles and named sheets as Microsoft's Accessibility Checker rules for Office files ask.

rules.text: Exported as a tagged PDF, the file passes PDF/UA-1 in veraPDF. Skipped where the tool is absent; see checks/pdfua.py for the exporter findings left out.
No slide text is hidden behind a picture or an opaque shape drawn over it.
rules.source: A defect check: text drawn under a picture or an opaque shape cannot be read. Ported from OfficeCLI.

note: Each rule says what it is: a published standard (WCAG 2.2, PDF/UA-1), a defect check (a file that loses text or figures), or a house convention (FLOOR-FONT). Sources recorded 2026-10-07.
